Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was an intersection in Houston, Texas. I was making a left turn across the oncoming lane.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had stopped at the light, then got the green arrow and started the turn. The other car came through from the
opposite direction, and we collided in the middle of the intersection.
Q: Did you see the other vehilce before you began your turn?
A: I checked, but it was farther back than I expected. I thought I had enough time to clear it.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My neck and lower back hurt right away. I've had stiffness and soreness since then, and I've been doing
physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Have you seen a doctor?
A: I went to urgent care the same day, and I've been referred to a specialist for follow-up.
Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?
A: No, they did not. I was able to get out of the car on my own.
Q: Has anything about your condition changed since the first visit?
A: Some days are better than others. Sitting for long periods is still hard, and I sometimes wake up with pain.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I want the cliam handled fairly so I can get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
